'''The Promise''' was the [[Rabaanite]] tradition of promising oneself to another on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rabaan]]. The Rabaanite [[warrior-artist]] [[Mika Streev]] intended to give his Promise to his long-term love [[Leda Kyss]].<ref name="Combat Moon">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>
